draft.title: Leaders of the People's Republic
card: Mao Zedong
Chairman of the Communist Party and the most powerful leader of the People's Republic. He put class struggle and constant revolution first.
Liu Shaoqi
Head of state in the early 1960s. After the Great Leap Forward he backed more practical, planned measures to rebuild the economy. Mao saw this as a turn away from revolution.
Lin Biao
Head of the army who built up Mao's personal standing. He was named Mao's successor in 1969. He died in 1971 after an apparent attempt to flee China.
Jiang Qing
Mao's wife. She led attacks on culture and on officials in the Cultural Revolution. She was arrested soon after Mao died in 1976.
draft.remember: The leaders clashed over whether to put revolution or practical rebuilding first, and Mao's view usually won.

a.q: Why did Mao and Liu Shaoqi come into conflict in the early 1960s?
opts: Liu backed practical rebuilding, and Mao saw a retreat
Liu wanted to end Communist rule, and Mao wanted it kept
Liu wanted to lead the army, and Mao wanted it for himself
Liu opposed Lin Biao as Mao's chosen successor in 1969
a.why: After the Great Leap Forward, Liu backed practical measures to rebuild the economy. Mao saw these as a retreat from revolution. Liu did not want to end Communist rule: he was a senior Communist leader.
a.clue: Think about what Liu wanted to do after the Great Leap Forward.

b.q: Which leader is correctly matched with their role in the struggle over the new state's direction?
opts: Lin Biao: army head who built up Mao's personal standing
Jiang Qing: head of state who backed practical rebuilding
Liu Shaoqi: army head who built up Mao's personal standing
Lin Biao: head of state who backed practical rebuilding
b.why: Lin Biao led the army and promoted Mao's standing. Liu Shaoqi, not Jiang Qing or Lin Biao, was head of state and backed practical rebuilding. Jiang Qing is tempting as a radical figure, but she led attacks on culture and officials.
b.clue: Match each person to the job named on the card.

a.best: Liu backed practical rebuilding, and Mao saw a retreat

b.best: Lin Biao: army head who built up Mao's personal standing

problems.detail: The remember line sorts all four leaders into a revolution-versus-rebuilding split, but the card shows only Mao and Liu clashing this way. It also says 'Mao's view usually won', which the card never states. The card does not mention Liu's fall or any outcome of the clashes.
